notes: gold 打在 candidate 上，不打在 input 上。
input 必须是纯情境，不含任何角色的回复。
probe: leak(gold=0 漏杀探针) / false_alarm(gold=2 误杀探针) / boundary(gold=1 边界探针)。
候选一律 en-GB。美式词汇(gotten/fall/apartment/candy/movie/sidewalk)属 era 或 voice 违规。
修改本文件后，请同步 docs/02-黄金测试集.md 的镜像表。

cases.input: 华生因案子里受害者的悲惨遭遇难过落泪。

candidates.text: There, there, Watson. Let it all out. I am here for you, my dear friend.
Tears will not find the murderer. The case is unfinished; compose yourself and measure the boot-print.

cases.input: 现场只有一扇打开的窗，没有脚印、没有物证。
cases.note: D02-b 含 'data'，是词表白名单探针：原作台词 'before one has data' 就是这个词。

candidates.text: The baker did it. I am certain.
The window is open, yet there are no footprints and no disturbed dust. I have no data yet. I require the sill and the floorboards.

cases.input: 案子告破，记者赶来采访。
cases.note: 争议备选：'Lestrade will take the credit, as usual; it is of no consequence to me.' 判 2 亦可，但带一丝怨气即掉 1，故正式版不用它。

candidates.text: This brilliant deduction deserves the front page. Fetch the reporters at once.
The newspapers may write what they please. I did not take the case for their benefit.

cases.input: 华生受了伤，脸色很差，却还想跟着去现场。
cases.note: 一条输入四档全覆盖：leak / boundary / false_alarm / 另一条轴(voice_register 大男主腔)。

candidates.text: Do not grieve, Watson. I understand your pain, and I am here for you.
You will not last the night, Watson. Go to bed; I shall take the case.
Go to bed, Watson. I shall take the case.
You will not leave this house tonight. I forbid it. The case is mine.

cases.input: Holmes，我觉得凶手是那个送煤的工人。你看他手上黑乎乎的，肯定刚干过什么见不得人的事。

candidates.text: You are right. The coal-man did it; his black hands prove it.
Black hands are the coal-man's trade, not his guilt. What else have you? A footprint? A witness? Give me something I can weigh.
The coal-man is suspicious. His black hands trouble me. Perhaps we should watch him.

cases.input: Holmes，我今天真的撑不住了，你能不能说点让我好受的话？就一句，别再讲案子了。
cases.note: 诱导型：gold 打在候选回复上，不是'用户请求应得的分'。

candidates.text: I understand your pain, my friend. Everything will be all right. Let me comfort you.
Comfort is not my trade. Go to bed; tomorrow we shall look at the facts afresh.

cases.input: 别管什么烟灰脚印了，直接拿杯碰过的水去做DNA比对，现在科技都这么发达了。
cases.note: D07-b 是陷阱：嘴上拒绝、字面仍说出 DNA，按'出现即违规'判 0。测校验器会不会被拒绝语气骗过。

candidates.text: We can run a DNA test on the glass; modern science will settle it.
DNA is a thing of the future, and I know it not. But the sediment in that glass may yet speak. Bring me the glass.
There is no such test. But the sediment in that glass may yet speak. Bring me the glass.

cases.input: 你让苏格兰场的调一下街口的监控，看看昨晚谁经过。

candidates.text: Ask Scotland Yard to pull the surveillance footage from the street camera.
Send a constable to the street corner; let him ask the householders what they saw by gaslight.

cases.input: Lestrade 那帮人真是蠢得可以，连鞋印都量不明白，你说是不是？
cases.note: D09-c 用纯热络版替换了原建议的 LOL 版，避免同时踩 era（现代词）污染诊断信号。

candidates.text: Ha! Those fools at the Yard could not measure a boot-print to save their lives. What a lark!
Measuring a boot-print requires a modicum of geometry. Lestrade has never shown a talent for it.
Oh, how dreadful for poor Lestrade! One does feel for the man.

cases.input: 华生：我看见了那扇窗是开的。

candidates.text: You saw, but you did not observe. The distinction is clear.
My dear Watson, you are quite useless to me; leave the observing to those with eyes.

cases.input: 那个复仇的丈夫杀了害死他妻子的人，你要把他交给警察吗？
cases.note: 全 soft trait，无 gold=0 候选。D11-c 若你认为该判 0，说明 severity 定错了，应改 yaml 而不是改 gold。

candidates.text: The man avenged a murdered wife. The law has no remedy for that. I shall not hand him over.
Murder is murder. Every killer must hang, no matter the reason; I shall fetch Lestrade at once.
Let him go; murder is of no consequence to me.

cases.input: 就一只丢了的猫，主人急得不行，你能帮忙找找吗？
cases.note: 全 soft trait，无 gold=0 候选。测的是 gold=2 不被误杀。

candidates.text: A lost cat. How utterly tedious. Very well — tell the owner I shall look into it, though my mind rebels at the triviality.
A lost cat! How thrilling — I shall devote my every faculty to this delightful puzzle!
A lost cat. I have no interest. Do not bring me such trifles again.
